name: Credit Approval (draft)
description: DRAFT — sketched directly from a business conversation, no target project referenced yet. Captures the shape only: customer requests a loan, the system analyzes credit, and routes to contract signature or a rejection notice. Every technical field a real deploy would need (providerType, executor, bean names) is deliberately left out rather than invented — see each node's own description for what's still an open technical decision. Validate against schemas/kikwi-draft.schema.json, not kikwi-deploy.schema.json, until those decisions are made; then run model-kikwi-process again in deploy mode over this same shape.

ANALYZE_CREDIT.name: Analyze Credit
ANALYZE_CREDIT.description: The system evaluates the customer's credit. Open technical decision: is this a synchronous rule engine call (EXECUTABLE_TASK, stays as-is) or does it depend on an external bureau/service that doesn't answer immediately (would need to become EXTERNAL_TASK instead)? Confirm with engineering before hardening.

CREDIT_DECISION.name: Credit Approved?
CREDIT_DECISION.description: Routes on the outcome of the credit analysis. Open technical decision: is the approve/reject call made by a rule engine bean (providerType: BEAN) or is it just reading a variable ANALYZE_CREDIT already set (providerType: VARIABLE)? Not decided yet — pick this during hardening, not here.

SEND_TO_SIGNATURE.name: Send to Contract Signature
SEND_TO_SIGNATURE.description: Customer signs the loan contract. Open technical decision: is this a human/external step (EXTERNAL_TASK, likely) or does an e-signature platform call back asynchronously via a correlation key (EVENT_CATCHER)? Depends on which e-signature integration the business ends up choosing.

NOTIFY_REJECTION.name: Notify Customer of Rejection
NOTIFY_REJECTION.description: Customer is informed the loan wasn't approved. Open technical decision: which channel (email/SMS/push) and whether it's synchronous — not discussed yet.
